description.en: Important questions on the mountain peaks and passes of India for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ভাৰতৰ পৰ্বত শৃঙ্গ আৰু গিৰিপথ সম্পৰ্কে অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: Which is the highest peak in the world?

a.en: Mount Everest, at 8,848 metres, in the Nepal Himalayas.
a.as: নেপাল হিমালয়ত অৱস্থিত মাউণ্ট এভাৰেষ্ট, ৮,৮৪৮ মিটাৰ।

q.en: Which is the highest peak of India?
Which is the highest peak of the Karakoram range?
Which is the highest peak of the Zanskar range?
Which is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
Which is the highest peak of the Western Ghats?
Which is the highest peak of the Satpura range?
Which is the highest peak of the Aravali range?

a.en: Guru Shikhar, at 1,722 metres, on Mount Abu.
a.as: আবু পৰ্বতত অৱস্থিত গুৰু শিখৰ, ১,৭২২ মিটাৰ।

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Nilgiri hills?
Which is the highest peak of the Vindhya range?
Which is the highest peak of the Eastern Himalayas in India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ পূব হিমালয়ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ শৃঙ্গ কোনটো?

q.en: Which pass connects Kashmir with Ladakh?
q.as: কাশ্মীৰ আৰু লাডাখ সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which pass connects Jammu with Srinagar?
q.as: জম্মু আৰু শ্ৰীনগৰ সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which is the highest motorable pass of the world?
Which pass connects Ladakh with Tibet?
q.as: লাডাখ আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which pass connects Sikkim with Tibet?
q.as: ছিক্কিম আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which pass connects Himachal Pradesh with Tibet?
q.as: হিমাচল প্ৰদেশ আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which pass connects Uttarakhand with Tibet?
q.as: উত্তৰাখণ্ড আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which is the famous pass of the Manas-Bhutan route?

a.en: The Bomdila pass in Arunachal Pradesh.

q.en: Which pass connects Arunachal Pradesh with Tibet?
q.as: অৰুণাচল প্ৰদেশ আৰু তিব্বত সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

a.en: The Dihang (Bomdila) and the Tawang pass routes.

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Western Himalayas?
Which is the highest peak of the Pir Panjal range?
q.as: পিৰ পাঞ্জাল শৃংখলাৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ শৃঙ্গ কোনটো?

q.en: Which peak of the Assam Himalayas is the highest?

a.en: The Gorichen peak, at about 6,488 metres, in Arunachal Pradesh.
a.as: অৰুণাচল প্ৰদেশত অৱস্থিত গ'ৰিচেন শৃঙ্গ, প্ৰায় ৬,৪৮৮ মিটাৰ।

q.en: Which is the famous peak of the Naga hills?

a.en: Saramati, at 3,826 metres, on the India-Myanmar border.

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Khasi hills?
Which is the highest peak of the Shillong plateau?
Which is the highest peak of the Patkai range?

a.en: The peaks of the Patkai Bum, including the Saramati.

q.en: Which pass is used by the pilgrims going to Kailash Mansarovar?
q.as: কৈলাশ মানসৰোৱৰলৈ যোৱা তীৰ্থযাত্ৰীসকলে ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

q.en: Which is the highest peak of the Ladakh range?

a.en: Rakaposhi and the peaks around the Siachen glacier.
a.as: ৰাকাপ'ছি আৰু ছিয়াচেন হিমবাহৰ আশেপাশৰ শৃঙ্গসমূহ।

q.en: Which is the famous peak of the Garhwal Himalayas?
Which is the highest peak of the Kumaon Himalayas?
Which pass connects the Nainital area with the hills?
q.as: নৈনিতাল অঞ্চল আৰু পাহাৰ সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?

a.en: The Niti and the Juhar passes.

q.en: Which is the famous peak of the Himalayas of Nepal?
Which is the highest peak of the Peninsular India?
Which pass connects Mizoram with Myanmar?
q.as: মিজোৰাম আৰু ম্যানমাৰ সংযোগী গিৰিপথ কোনটো?
